title: Acquirer: Alcoa Inc; Target: Kaal Australia Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Alcoa Inc is proposing a joint venture buy-out that will involve Alcoa increasing its stake in Kaal Australia from 50% to 100% by acquiring Kobe Steel's 50% stake.
body_sections.Market definition: The Commission did not consider the issue of market definition to be decisive because under any definition there was unlikely to be a substantial lessening of competition.  However, the following markets were considered: - the market for aluminium can stock; - the market for aluminium foil sheet; and - the market for aluminium general sheet.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission considered it unlikely that the proposed acquisition would substantially lessen competition in any markets.  The Commission took into consideration the fact that the acquisition will not remove a market participant, as neither Alcoa Inc nor Kobe Steel market or sell Kaal Australia's aluminium products independently.
